description: Answers 'what changed' and 'any news on X': recent tax rule changes Heed has published (enacted, in force or proposed), newest first, optionally for one country. Each carries its status, effective date, severity and official source. Use get_change_cost with an item's id for what it costs per 10,000 of the income it touches.

country.description: Optional two-letter code or country name.

status.description: Optional status filter; default every live status.
